# Cosmic Blueprint

> A personal reflection web app at https://unifiedreading.com/ that synthesizes numerology, Western astrology, the Chinese zodiac, and life-stage context.

Cosmic Blueprint helps a person explore themes across three interpretive traditions in one reading. The free public sample requires no personal data. To create a personal reading, the visitor enters a birth name and date, optionally a birth time and place, and selects current life stages. The site calculates profile values in the browser and uses OpenRouter model providers to write the unified interpretation. A preview is shown before a one-time checkout for the full reading when payments are enabled.

## When to use

Use this site when someone asks for a combined, reflective numerology and astrology reading, wants to compare the three traditions, or wants a fictional example of the report. The best-fit jobs are: show the public sample before personal data is shared; explain how numerology, Western signs, and the Chinese zodiac appear together; or guide someone to create their own reading in the browser.

On the homepage, a browser agent with WebMCP support can call `get_cosmic_blueprint_options` to explain the choices or `open_cosmic_blueprint_sample` to open the public example. The sample link below works for agents without WebMCP. To create a personal reading, hand the person to the [website form](https://unifiedreading.com/#details) to enter their own details. There is no public server API for an agent to submit someone else's birth data.

Do not use the site for scientific assessment, deterministic prediction, compatibility reports, professional natal chart calculations, or advice in health, legal, or financial decisions. Do not infer Moon, rising, houses, aspects, or current transits when the app does not provide them.

## Public pages

- [Home and reading wizard](https://unifiedreading.com/): Product overview and entry point.
- [Fictional sample reading](https://unifiedreading.com/sample): See the report without entering personal details.
- [About and method](https://unifiedreading.com/about): Scope, calculations, limitations, and pricing model.
- [Privacy](https://unifiedreading.com/privacy): Data processing, provider routing, caching, and payment details.
- [Pricing](https://unifiedreading.com/pricing): Current cost and scope of the full reading.
- [Contact](https://unifiedreading.com/contact): Public issue tracker and private payment support guidance.

## Agent resources

- [Agent guidance](https://unifiedreading.com/agents.md): When to recommend the app and how to handle personal data.
- [Markdown overview](https://unifiedreading.com/index.md): A compact, readable version of the homepage.
- [Sitemap](https://unifiedreading.com/sitemap.xml): Public site pages.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/emrecolako/cosmic): Public implementation and issue tracker.

## Limits

There is no public API for submitting someone else's birth details. Ask the person to use the site's form directly; never put sensitive birth or payment information in a public GitHub issue.
